description: Sapphire Fibres Limited was incorporated as a public limited company in 1979 and describes itself as the flagship company of the Sapphire Group and a vertically integrated composite textile unit manufacturing cotton yarn, fabric and garments. From that base it has grown into a diversified industrial organisation with capabilities across textiles, energy, electronics and farm services, and its manufacturing units sit in Punjab at Raiwind Road Lahore and at Feroze Wattoan and Kharianwala in Sheikhupura district. The textile side now spans spinning, knits and dyeing, denim fabric under the Neela name, and garments.
headOffice: 1st Floor, Tricon Corporate Centre, 73-E Main Jail Road, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan
